text:
Nora (Growth): Idea: run a small PLG benchmark for our next webinar — combine 3 launch-post narratives + 30 starter tokens and measure which narrative drives fastest conversion to first 3 requests. Call it 'SparkBench'.

Ethan: Nice name. What are the 3 narratives?

Nora (Growth): 1) "Build-in-5" (developer-first), 2) "Ship-copy-fast" (marketing templates), 3) "Digest-docs" (summaries). Each gets a tailored launch post and in-console banner.

Priya: Audience: webinar RSVPs + recent signups (n=360). Split 60/40. Randomize narrative assignment and credit delivery. Exclude paid and anyone with credits in last 30d.

Devon: Routing plan: tag cohorts `spark_web` / `spark_signup`. Credit payload: 30 tokens TTL=7d. Will post config to #eng-infra. Small snippet for routing: `experiment: sparkbench_v1; cohorts: ["spark_web","spark_signup"]; credit:30; ttl:7`

Maya: Metrics: primary = pct with >=3 meaningful requests by day7. Secondary = time-to-first-request and tokens used. Also capture engagement per launch-post (clicks on post). analytics-bot can provide baseline.

analytics-bot: queued report `sparkbench_baseline_30d`. Link: https://internal.data/reports/sparkbench_baseline_30d. ETA 20m.

Nora (Growth): Messaging cadence: Day0 email + in-console surfacing, Day2 reminder + example prompts, Day5 testimonial micro-post. Keep copy concise and focused on quick wins.

Ethan: For measurement, do A/B of subject lines for each narrative. Also sample 25 users for a 1-question in-app probe on day3.

Priya: I'll draft launch-post copy and three example prompt packs today. Will localize EN/ES for the email subject lines.

Devon: Posting routing config to infra now. Note: ensure we exclude users in other active credit experiments to avoid overlap.

Maya: I'll prep the dashboard, set alerts for regressions, and wire cohort filters. Check-in Friday 9am PT to review the baseline and mockups.

Nora (Growth): Owners: Nora (strategy), Priya (creative), Devon (routing), Maya (analysis). Budget: 360*30 = 10.8k tokens. If top narrative >12% lift, scale to full webinar list. Rolling Monday if no blockers. :rocket:
